english.title: Engage in estate agency work having failed to attain the required standard of competence
english.standardoffencewording:

(A)_[engaged in estate agency work on your own account having failed to attain]_
(B)_[being a member of a partnership, engaged in estate agency work on the partnership's behalf when insufficient partners had attained]_
(C)_[being a body corporate, engaged in estate agency work when the prescribed numbers and descriptions of the officers, members or employees had not attained]_
(D)_[being an unincorporated association, engaged in estate agency work when the prescribed numbers and descriptions of the officers, members or employees had not attained]_

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit on Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
